project_name.justification: The project is consistently referred to as the 'Rip Project' or 'Rip Cu-Mo Project' throughout the documents, for example: 'Interra Copper Announces Letter of Intent for Rip Copper-Molybdenum Project Earn-In'.

company_name.justification: The text identifies the acquiring company: 'Interra Copper Corp. (CSE: IMCX) (OTCQB: IMIMF) (FSE: 3MX) ("Interra" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has entered into a non-binding letter of intent (the "LOI") with ArcWest Exploration Inc. (TSXV: AWX) ("ArcWest"), to negotiate an 80% earn-in and joint venture agreement on ArcWest's Rip Cu-Mo Project'.

ceo_buyer.justification: The press releases are signed 'On behalf of the Board of Interra Copper Corp. Rick Gittleman Interim CEO & Chairman'.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement is for a farm-in with a maximum potential interest: 'Under the terms of the LOI, Interra obtains a two-stage option to earn up to an 80% ownership interest in the Rip Project over up to an 8-year period.'

primary_commodity.justification: The project is named the 'Rip Copper-Molybdenum Project', indicating copper and molybdenum as the key commodities. 'Interra Copper Corp. and ArcWest Exploration Inc. Execute Rip Copper-Molybdenum Project Option and Joint Venture Agreement'.

verified_article_link.justification: The article is titled 'Interra Copper Announces Letter of Intent for Rip Copper-Molybdenum Project Earn-In', which directly concerns the specified project.

currency.justification: The financial terms are specified in Canadian dollars: '...completing geological and exploration expenditures of Cdn $2,000,000, and paying Cdn $100,000 cash to ArcWest...'

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total potential cash payment is C$2,150,000, aggregated from all stages. Stage 1: 'paying Cdn $100,000 cash to ArcWest'. Stage 2: 'paying ArcWest C$250,000 per year' (for 4 years = $1,000,000). Extension: 'continuing C$250,000 annual payment to ArcWest plus an additional C$100,000 per year' (for 3 years = $1,050,000).

share_payments_raw.justification: The number of shares is specified, but no cash value is assigned to them in the transaction terms.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: Cash and share components of the deal are listed separately, not as a single combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: In the 1st stage, Interra has the option to earn, over a 4-year staged work-schedule, a 60% share ownership in the Rip by issuing 1,050,000 shares of Interra...

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants are mentioned as part of the transaction terms.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options are mentioned as part of the transaction payment.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the issuance of 1,050,000 shares but not the price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.09'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The exploration commitment is specified as a monetary value, not in meters of drilling.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The total potential exploration commitment is C$10,000,000, aggregated from all stages. Stage 1: 'completing geological and exploration expenditures of Cdn $2,000,000'. Stage 2: 'funding C$2 million in work'. Extension: 'a minimum of C$2,000,000 of annual exploration during the extension period' (for 3 years = $6,000,000).

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: No Net Smelter Royalty (NSR) or Gross Revenue Royalty (GRR) is mentioned as being acquired or retained in the transaction terms.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The Rip Project comprises 2,309 ha and is located about 63 km south of Houston and 79 km southwest of Burns Lake in central British Columbia.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The Rip Project comprises 2,309 ha and is located about 63 km south of Houston and 79 km southwest of Burns Lake in central British Columbia.

resource_size.justification: The text does not contain a formal mineral resource estimate with tonnage. It only mentions historical drill intercepts like '0.07% Cu and 0.005% Mo over 70.3 meters' and notes that 'this area will require an extensive drilling program to determine whether a zone of economic mineralization exists', implying no resource has been defined.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The acquiring company is identified with its ticker and exchange in the text: 'Interra Copper Corp. (CSE: IMCX)'.
